method: Content-read all nine complete test files, comparing fixture shapes, real Api/IndexedDB durable boundaries, navigation ownership and workflow revisions to production contracts already examined in runtime/deployment review. No source edits and no tests executed during frozen audit. This is a test-semantic supplement for the independent web reviewer, not independent approval of frontend implementation authored by this reviewer.
observations: workspace-git-drafts: draft retention and hidden inert controls, stale preview abort, fresh confirmation, owner ABA invalidation, original receipt query and no resend, late old-owner receipt remains global.

workspace-handoff: real Workspace callbacks with presentation hooks replaced; tests actual draft revision rather than text equality, storage failure navigation guard, accepted receipt versus HTTP arrival ordering, new text/attachments/options/context/schema while sending, archive and branch/review handoff without navigation theft.

workspace-management: recovery not_found versus generic error, exact source revision and manifest, backup-local status never promotes global accepted, live worktree phase/revision, idle gate, original unknown receipt, complete HEAD/index re-read, discard and per-action consent ownership.

workspace-search: literal project-scoped request, explicit exclusion list and incomplete result explanation, query-change stale response fencing. Second title mentions project change but body actually exercises query change only; do not use it as separate project-change evidence.

workspace-ui: path/identity guards, UTF-8/NUL limits, fresh overwrite revision, post-submit draft rebasing only after readback, no replay of unknown mutation, failed local intent storage blocks dispatch, late owner response, binary/large content limits, explicit nonrecursive deletion, project-separated file drafts and constrained Git review target.
workspace-watch: no overlapping reads, complete baseline kept on one sibling failure, timer and signal cancellation on disable/disconnect/unmount, old epoch cannot restart replacement schedule.

git-index-ui: staging both rename paths, deletion only after exact not_found, HEAD/index version binding, unstage without touching worktree content, original receipt only, backup manifest and whole-index explicit restore.

project-create: new/add flows, duplicate existing project retains original name, accepted-without-id and unknown outcomes never resend, relative/absolute normalization on root/native plus Windows dev paths, unsafe/control/Unicode/byte budgets, actual execution identity changes discard defaults but preserve typed text.

project-handoff: full App integration through real IndexedDB/API admission with fake transport; keeps old project draft, navigates accepted destination only when safe, blocks submission when ROOT identity becomes unconfirmed. No browser-layout or real backend evidence is inferred from jsdom.
limitations: Read-only semantic audit; does not claim these tests passed in this round.
Mock network/native shapes do not establish real production I/O or mobile rendering; native and browser evidence is separate.
No new actionable defects found in these nine test files.
startTimeBasis: Earliest bound: began immediately after completing the runtime report and accepting the remaining test review; per-tool timestamps were not separately persisted.
